verses.text: Yahweh told Moses, ‘Give Aaron’s sons—the priests—this word: a priest must not make himself ritually unclean while mourning someone who dies among his people. 🕯️
There’s an exception for close family: his mother, father, son, daughter, or brother, 👪
or his unmarried sister, who’s close family and has no husband. For her, he may become ritually unclean. 🕯️
But as a leader among his people, a priest must not make himself unclean for anyone else or profane himself. ⚖️
‘Priests must not shave their heads, shave off the edges of their beards, or cut their bodies. 🚫
They must be holy to their God and not drag his name down, because they bring Yahweh’s fire offerings—the food of their God. They must stay holy. 🕊️
‘They must not marry a woman who has been a prostitute or dishonored, or a woman divorced from her husband, because the priest is holy to his God. 💍
You must set the priest apart, because he brings your God’s food offering. He must be holy to you, because I, Yahweh who makes you holy, am holy. 🙏
‘If a priest’s daughter makes herself dishonorable by becoming a prostitute, she dishonors her father. She must be burned with fire. ⚠️
‘The high priest—the one anointed with oil and set apart to wear the priestly clothes—must not let his hair hang loose or tear his clothes. 👑
He must not go near a dead body or make himself ritually unclean, not even for his father or mother. 🚫
He must not leave the sanctuary or profane his God’s holy place, because his God’s anointing rests on him. I am Yahweh. 🕊️
‘He must marry a woman who is a virgin. 💍
He must not marry a widow, a divorced woman, a woman who has been dishonored, or a prostitute. He must take a virgin from his own people as his wife. ⚖️
He must not profane his descendants among his people, because I am Yahweh, the one who makes him holy.’ 🕊️
Yahweh spoke to Moses again: 📣
‘Tell Aaron: through every generation, none of your descendants with a physical impairment may come forward to present their God’s food offering. 📜
Anyone with a physical impairment must not come forward: someone blind, lame, with a flat nose, or with any other deformity, 👁️
or with an injured foot or hand, 🩹
with a hunched back, dwarfism, an eye defect, an itching skin disease, scabs, or damaged testicles. 🩺

No descendant of Aaron the priest with a physical impairment may come forward to present Yahweh’s fire offerings. Because of that impairment, he must not approach the altar to present his God’s food offering. ⚠️
He may still eat his God’s food, including the most holy and the holy offerings. 🍽️
But he must not approach the curtain or altar because of his impairment, so he won’t profane my holy places. I am Yahweh, who makes them holy.’ 🕊️
Moses passed these instructions on to Aaron, his sons, and all Israel. 📜
